title: Merge Nodes in Between Zeros
summary: Given a linked list with integers separated by zeros, merge consecutive nodes between each pair of zeros into a single node with the sum of those nodes.
statement: Given a linked list with integers separated by zeros, merge consecutive nodes between each pair of zeros into a single node with the sum of those nodes. Remove all zero nodes. Return the modified linked list head.
constraints: The linked list begins and ends with zero, with no consecutive zero nodes.
Sum each nonempty group strictly between consecutive zeros.
Return a new list containing one sum per group and no zero separator nodes.
hints: Zero nodes are delimiters, so keep a running group total.
Skip the initial zero; accumulate positive values and emit a node whenever the next zero appears.
Maintain a dummy output tail, append ListNode(total) at each separator, reset total, and return dummy.next.
Each input value belongs to exactly one delimiter-bounded group and contributes once to exactly one output node.
editorial: Each input value belongs to exactly one delimiter-bounded group and contributes once to exactly one output node.

tests.explanation: The groups 3+1 and 4+5+2 become the list [4,11].
The three groups sum to 1, 3, and 4.
